```{r,echo=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(glue)
cost_energy_plot <- function(file_path, weighted_points = TRUE,targetCol="cost") {
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)

  df <- read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

  if (!("probability" %in% names(df)) && ("prob" %in% names(df))) {
    df <- df %>% rename(probability = prob)
  }


  if (!all(c("energy", targetCol) %in% names(df))) {
    stop("not energy or cost")
  }

  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      energy = as.numeric(energy),
      cost = as.numeric(.data[[targetCol]]),
      probability = as.numeric(count),
      cost = factor(cost, levels = sort(unique(cost))) 
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(energy), is.finite(probability), probability >= 0)

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = cost, y = energy)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(
      aes(size = if (weighted_points) probability else NULL),
      width = 0.18, alpha = 0.35
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "Cost", y = "Energy", title = "Energy distribution by Cost")

  if (weighted_points) {
    p <- p + scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.5, 6))
  }

  print(p)
}




```

```{r,echo=FALSE}
data_process <- function(file_path, output, num=0, keep_fallback = TRUE) {
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(glue)

  lines <- readLines(file_path, warn = FALSE)
  start_idx <- grep("^#\\s*all_solutions\\s*$", lines)

  if (length(start_idx) == 0) {
    stop("no # all_solutions found")
  }

  all_lines <- lines[(start_idx + 1):length(lines)]
  all_lines <- all_lines[all_lines != ""]

  df <- read_csv(
    I(paste(all_lines, collapse = "\n")),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )

  process <- df

  if (!is.null(keep_fallback)) {
    process <- process %>%
      arrange(bitstring, used_fallback != keep_fallback)
  }

  process <- process %>%
    distinct(bitstring, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(index = row_number())

  write.csv(
    process,
    glue("{output}/processed/readout_summary_eval{num}.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}
cost_energy_boxplot_prob <- function(file_path, show_points = TRUE,targetCol="cost",thresh="()",opt="",fallback=FALSE,target) {
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  
  lines <- readLines(file_path, warn = FALSE)
  start_idx <- grep("^#\\s*all_solutions\\s*$", lines)

  if (length(start_idx) == 0) {
    stop("no # all_solution find")
  }

  all_lines <- lines[(start_idx + 1):length(lines)]
  all_lines <- all_lines[all_lines != ""]

  df <- read_csv(
    I(paste(all_lines, collapse = "\n")),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )

  
 ## df <- read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE, text = paste(all_lines, collapse = "\n"),
## stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  if (!("probability" %in% names(df)) && ("prob" %in% names(df))) {
    df <- df %>% rename(probability = prob)
  }

  df <- df %>%
    transmute(
      used_fallback=as.logical(used_fallback),
      cost = as.numeric(.data[[targetCol]]),
      energy = as.numeric(energy),
      probability = as.numeric(probability)
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(energy), probability > 0,used_fallback == fallback)

  w0 <- min(df$probability)
  df_exp <- df %>%
    mutate(w = pmax(1L, round(probability / w0))) %>%
    uncount(w)

  p <- ggplot(df_exp, aes(x = factor(cost), y = energy)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = targetCol, y = "Energy",
         title = glue("Energy vs {targetCol}; thres: {thresh};opt:{opt}; used_fallback={fallback} "))

  if (show_points) {
    br <- sort(unique(df$probability))
    p <- p +
      geom_point(
        data = df,
        aes(size = probability),
        alpha = 0.5,
        position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0)
      ) +
      scale_size_continuous(breaks = br, labels = br, name = "probability")
  }
  cost_counts <- df %>%
  count(cost, name = "n_rows") %>%
  mutate(pct = n_rows / sum(n_rows)) %>%
  arrange(cost)
  print(glue("Matrix for used_fallback={fallback}"))
  print(cost_counts)
  print(p)

return(list(
  cost_counts[cost_counts$cost == target, ]$pct
))  }

```

```{r}
plot_energy_from_csv <- function(file_path, baseline = NULL) {
  df <- read.csv(file_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  energy <- df$energy
  
  y_limits <- if (!is.null(baseline)) {
    range(c(energy, baseline), na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    range(energy, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  
  if ("iteration" %in% colnames(df)) {
    plot(
      df$iteration, energy,
      type = "b",
      pch = 19,
      xlab = "Iteration",
      ylab = "Energy",
      main = "Energy over Iteration",
      ylim = y_limits
    )
  } else {
    plot(
      seq_along(energy), energy,
      type = "b",
      pch = 19,
      xlab = "Index",
      ylab = "Energy",
      main = "Energy",
      ylim = y_limits
    )
  }
  
  if (!is.null(baseline)) {
    abline(h = baseline, col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
    legend(
      "topright",
      legend = c("Energy", "Baseline"),
      col = c("black", "red"),
      lty = c(1, 2),
      pch = c(19, NA),
      bty = "n"
    )
  }
  
  return(energy)
}


```

```{r}
# functio for plotting energies from two csvs in the same graph 
plot_energy_comparison <- function(file_random, file_spiq) {
  
  # Read the CSV files
  df_random <- read.csv(file_random)
  df_spiq   <- read.csv(file_spiq)
  
  # Basic sanity check
  if (!all(c("iteration", "energy") %in% colnames(df_random))) {
    stop("Random file must contain 'iteration' and 'energy' columns")
  }
  
  if (!all(c("iteration", "energy") %in% colnames(df_spiq))) {
    stop("SPIQ file must contain 'iteration' and 'energy' columns")
  }
  
  # Plot random initialization first
  plot(
    df_random$iteration,
    df_random$energy,
    type = "l",
    col = "blue",
    lwd = 2,
    xlab = "Iteration",
    ylab = "Energy",
    main = "Energy vs Iteration (QAOA)",
  )
  
  # Add SPIQ line
  lines(
    df_spiq$iteration,
    df_spiq$energy,
    col = "red",
    lwd = 2
  )
  
  # Add legend
  legend(
    "topright",
    legend = c("random initialization", "spiq initialization"),
    col = c("blue", "red"),
    lwd = 2
  )
}
```
